title: 4" paring knife
text: 4" paring knife. These are small, 4" very pointy paring knives - You get 1, I ordered 2.  The tang is the full handle, however, they are super lightweight.  I was hoping for something a bit more weighty and better balanced and maybe not so pointy - but they will work.  They keep an edge about as well as my others.  Time will tell about wear and longevity.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. product_metadata.title: Gioventù Paring Knife 5 inch - Small Kitchen Knife Forged from German Stainless Steel 5Cr15Mov (HRC58), Full Tang, Sharp Paring Knife for Cutting, Peeling, Slicing Fruits and Vegetables
features: [High-quality Blade Material]: Constructed from high quality German stainless steel 5Cr15Mov(one of the most popular kitchen knife steels in mainstream German knives) which allows the blade to retain its edge for enduring, high-performance results.

[Great Balance]: Great Balance is one of the most important features that should take into consideration when choosing a paring knife. Full tang construction distributes weight more evenly along the knife which provides great balance and leverage capabilities.

[Non-Slip Ergonomic Handle]: Ergonomically shaped handle offers you an ideal place to position your thumb while keeping a secure, comfortable grip. With flawless polishing process, the handle will not become slippery even when dampened with moisture.

[Razor Sharp Edge]: A sharp knife means more control and less slippage when you cut, leading to safer, more consistent slices. Three times lower speed edge grinding process make the small kitchen knife sharp as a razor.
